performance_scope: Existing shop-detail and pprof evidence retained; new coupon path has correctness evidence only.
known_limitations: Preserved legacy Redis generations require fenced rebuild; incomplete state fails closed.
Coupon cache uses fixed 30s TTL and 10s negative TTL without jitter or Pub/Sub.
Cross-instance L1 invalidation is TTL-bounded; the durable dispatcher invalidates the current process and shared Redis.
Async historical timing ends at orders.created_at or first observed terminal state, not transaction commit completion.
